# A 100.00 invoice settled three ways, so its lot's splits span three
# transactions: 40.00 retargeted off one deposit, 30.00 off another, and 30.00
# out of the customer's standing credit.
#
# Unposted, all three are marked — but only two were paid by a bank; the third
# was credit and stays credit. A listing that reads the mark off one
# transaction's splits sees only the first, picks the second, and reports the
# credit's remaining 30.00 against a bank payment's date and account — a guid
# that a `from_credit:` block is then refused for naming.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_credit_payment_block_is_checked.py.
invoice "INV-THREE-WAYS"
	customer_id: "C-TWO-A"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-07-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-07-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-07-02
		due: 2026-08-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-THREE-WAYS"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-07-10
		amount: 40
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_ONE"
		memo: "First cash"
	payment:
		date: 2026-07-11
		amount: 30
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_TWO"
		memo: "Second cash"
	payment:
		amount: 30
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-07-05
		txn_guid: "TXN_CREDIT"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_CREDIT"
		memo: "And the rest from credit"
